Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

layaR (development version)

  • laya_annotate() gains answer_confidence, which adds an <id>_answer_confidence column: the confidence in the answer given (for a choice question, the chosen option’s probability), the number min_confidence compares with its threshold.
  • laya_annotate() explains that state takes column names as strings when given bare names (state = c(subject, body)), instead of failing with “object not found”.
  • New website article, “Using layaR with the tidyverse”, showing the data-frame workflows with dplyr, tidyr, purrr and ggplot2.

layaR 0.1.0

First release. layaR runs Laya decision models locally from R through the laya-onnx Rust crate and ONNX Runtime.

Questions and predictions

  • laya_choice(), laya_score() and laya_noul() build typed questions; laya_questions() combines them. laya_preset() gives the Python SDK’s five presets (triage, email, guard, moderation, router).
  • laya_predict() answers every question about a state in one forward pass; laya_predict_batch() does it for many states, in interruptible chunks with a progress bar; laya_predict_long() scans documents longer than the model’s context.
  • laya_predict_batch() sends one state per forward pass by default, which is fastest on a CPU (unlike the Python SDK, which batches a whole chunk). The layaR.batch_size option changes the default; ?layaR lists all options.
  • min_confidence reports, per answer, whether it passed an abstention threshold.
  • Results print compactly and convert with as.data.frame() and laya_probabilities(); they keep the Python SDK’s shape.
  • laya_annotate() adds the answers to a data frame as columns: a factor for choice questions, the expected level for scores, P(true) for yes/no questions.
  • Question sets read and write the Python SDK’s JSON format (as_laya_questions(), laya_questions_to_json()).

Models

  • laya_download_model() downloads ONNX exports from Hugging Face (gueyenono/laya-onnx by default), resumably.
  • laya_import_model() adds an export you made yourself; laya_models(), laya_remove_model() and laya_model_root() manage them. Exports in the cache shared with Laya’s Rust and TypeScript SDKs are found too.
  • laya_engine() loads a checkpoint (multilingual, English or typed-decisions); the prediction functions use laya_default_engine(). Engines refuse to run after fork() instead of hanging, and reconnect after saveRDS() or in PSOCK workers.

Text utilities

  • laya_detect_language(), laya_clean_email() and laya_email_state(), ported from the Python SDK. They need no model.

Compatibility

  • Results match the Python SDK on all 117 recorded cases for each of the English and multilingual checkpoints, and on all language and email probes.
  • Errors have class laya_error and laya_error_<kind>.
  • Linux and macOS. Windows is not supported yet.
